name: home-church-video
description: The App Store preview for Home Church, rendered from the app itself with Remotion.

scripts.studio: npm run stage && remotion studio src/index.jsx
scripts.render: npm run stage && remotion render src/index.jsx AppStorePreview out/home-church-app-store.mp4
scripts.render:marketing: npm run stage && remotion render src/index.jsx Marketing out/home-church-marketing.mp4
scripts.still: npm run stage && remotion still src/index.jsx AppStorePreview out/still.png
